successCriteria.description: README.md contains a section documenting the five local run commands in this exact order: `npm run migrate`, `npm run seed`, `npm run start` (API), `npm run dev` in `web/` (web dev server), then `npm run dev` at the root (combined runner).
README.md documents the demo credentials exactly: `manager@example.com` and `employee@example.com`, both with the shared password `demo-password` (the same literal the seed hardcodes).
README.md states the seed is development data only and never runs as part of `npm run migrate` (migrate runs only `knex migrate:latest`; seeding is a separate `knex seed:run` step).
Every command documented in README.md exists and is wired: root `migrate`/`seed`/`start`/`dev` in package.json and `dev` in web/package.json — no documented command is missing or renamed.

constraints: The documented commands must match the wired scripts exactly — root `migrate` = `knex migrate:latest`, `seed` = `knex seed:run`, `start` = `ts-node src/index.ts`, `dev` = `node scripts/dev.js`, and web `dev` = `vite`. Do not document any command that is not wired in package.json / web/package.json.
The shared password must be documented as the literal `demo-password` (BINDING rule 3), the same literal the seed hardcodes — not read from an environment variable and not paraphrased.
The seed must be described as development-only data that is separate from migrations and never runs as part of `npm run migrate`.
outOfScope: No production code, scripts, or seed data changes — this phase only adds documentation to README.md. The migrate/seed/start/dev scripts and the seed dataset are already delivered in prior phases and are treated as fixed.
Documenting production deployment, CI, or any command beyond the five local run commands (migrate, seed, start, web dev, root dev) is out of scope.

consistencyRequirements.requirement: The documented command names and their underlying scripts must match the root package.json `scripts` block exactly (migrate, seed, start, dev).
The documented web dev command must match the `dev` script in the web subproject exactly (`vite`).
The documented demo credentials and shared password must match the seed's hardcoded literals exactly (`manager@example.com`, `employee@example.com`, `demo-password`).
The documented combined dev runner behavior (spawns API via `npm run start` and web via `npm run dev` in `web/`, prefixed output, Ctrl-C teardown) must match the implemented runner.
